notes.title: Update Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Dear Commanders,

In this update patch 1.0.2 the main changes are related to quality of life improvements.
Moreover, there are some balance changes, polish and bugfixes.

Here are the patch notes of the latest patch 1.0.2:

Main changes


 Added WASD keysbindings to control the camera movement
 Added E keybinding to upgrade a tower
 Keybindings in settings menu added for pause, upgrade tower and camera movement
 Showing achievement needed to unlock a tower
 Added different sounds
 Technology text numbers highlighted
 Button in the top left to show the current difficulty and galaxy


Balance changes


 Increased difference between spawning rate based on map size
 Larger map has increased corruption spawning rate
 Weed wave ability more consistent


Corruption bugs squashed


 Technologies not saved when quitting the game
 Technologies not resetting after a finished run
 Random neighbour search crash


Please provide your feedback here

notes.title: Update Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello all,

After the release there were some much needed corruption bugs that need to be eliminated.
Fortunately, they were dealt with in a relatively short amount of time.

Here are the patch notes for patch 1.0.1

Main changes


 2 Options added to delete the saves files of an expedition or of the whole game
 Added corruption ability icons
 Corruption abilities added to all the bosses


Balance changes


 Corruption spawn rate decreased especially on lower difficulties
 Spitter subtype has a much lower rate of spreading corruption
 The corruption spawning rate and health will be adjusted based on the map size
 Flaming Cannon tower damage to 20 
 Raging Spire tower damage to 45 
 Bomber towers HP adjusted
 Gravler tower cost to 80
 Lake tower cost to 120
 Puffer tower damage to 75


Corruption bugs squashed


 Using save files from the demo
 Technologies not resetting after a run
 Corruption boss HP increasing exponentially
 Flaming cannon tower animation bug


Please provide your feedback here

notes.title: Hotfix: Save files used from the demo
notes.content:
Hotfixes:
- Fix: Save files used from the demo will be renamed and not be used anymore
- Fix: Damage suppression abillity may stack so the boss takes no damage

Other changes:
- Descriptions added to the corruption bosses

notes.title: Micron Defense Force is out now!
notes.content:
Attention commanders,

Proud to announce that Micron Defense Force is out now!
To celebrate the release, the game will have a 20% discount for the upcoming 2 weeks.


 The game features 3 factions.
 Each with their own towers and upgrades.
 Technologies to unlock.
 Difficulty levels to choose from.
 Different biomes.
 Many steam achievements to complete.

It is time to defend the galaxy and fight back against the corruption spread!


If you have feedback or encounter any bugs, please report them here

notes.title: Update Patch 0.9.0.0
notes.content:
The release of the game is getting closer and with that a new major patch of the Micron Defense Force Demo has been released!

The main change of this patch V0.9.0.0 is the addition of a tutorial on the first stage.
After this patch there will probably be one last major patch of the demo, since the main focus will be on releasing the full game.

Main changes


 A tutorial added at the first stage of the game
 Corruption intro scene background music and sounds added


Balance changes


 No corruption abilities in the first stage
 Decreased overall spawning rate of the corruption
 Crypto cache gold decreased to 300 from 500


Corruption bugs squashed


 Loading wrong stage planets
 Windowed mode only displaying a fraction of the whole screen
 Stage ranks not cleared after a run


Please provide your feedback here

notes.title: Update Patch 0.8.0.0
notes.content:
The third major patch of the Micron Defense Force Demo has been released!

The main change of this patch V0.8.0.0 are related to the combat with new corruption abilties.

Main changes


 Corruptions now have abilities that will activate during battle
 Mission ranks are displayed at the top so you can keep track of your score
 The amount of stages increased from 3 to 5
 Tower UI updated with each tower having an element
 New music on defeat, victory and in the menu scene
 Tower sound effects added
 Upgrade tower animation added
 Corruption boss health and percentage remaining health shown
 Damage numbers are shown


Balance changes


 Amount of technology experience required is halved.
 Lower spawn rate of the spitter corruption subtype significantly
 Corruption boss maximum health decreased for the first 2 stages
 Crypto cache gold decreased to 500 from 1000


Corruption bugs squashed


 Stage not saving after a mission won
 Corruption overlay showing the wrong sprite when upgrading
 Charge effect not removed from all towers when the source tower is destroyed


Please provide your feedback here

notes.title: Update Patch 0.7.0.0
notes.content:
The second major patch of the Micron Defense Force Demo has been released!

The main change of this patch V0.7.0.0 is the ability to collect resources on each planet.

Main changes


 3 Different types of resources to collect (ores, bloomers and crystals)
 3 New stages added including a large stage
 Mission UI updated
 Gradual transition when the corruption takes over
 Tower sound effects added
 Poison weed technology changed to bomber fuse which gives bombers 10% chance to deal burning damage.


Balance changes


 Mine damage has been halved.


Corruption bugs squashed


 Hit effect not showing on tentacle

notes.title: Update Patch 0.6.0.0
notes.content:
The first major patch of the Micron Defense Force Demo V0.6.0.0 has been released!

There are 2 main changes this patch.
The first is that there is an energy grid that restricts placing new towers anywhere on the map, so you have to gradually expand your defenses.
The other main change is the ability to change keybindings for keyboard and mouse in the settings menu.

Main changes


 Energy grid added to place new towers on
 Visual added to show which tower you will place on the energy grid
 Controls tab added in the settings menu to change the keybindings for keyboard and mouse


Corruption bugs squashed


 Towers disabled at the start of the game
 Multiple planets selected
 Grid was not aligned on some stages
 Bomber towers were not working due to the low cooldown when multiple accelerator technologies were selected
 Able to pause while the mission accomplished UI was showing
 Money continues to increment when the mission has ended

notes.title: The Micron Defense Force Demo is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello there! I am excited to announce that the Demo of Micron Defense Force is out NOW!

The Demo will consist of 3 stages and you will be able to replay the game as many times as you want.
Join the Defense Force and fight back against the corruption.
In this Roguelike Tower Defense you build towers and discover technologies to beat the spreading bosses.

If you find any bugs or have feedback to share you can do following:
- To report a bug click the 'Report bug' button in the menu and fill in the form.
- To give feedback click the 'Feedback' button in the pause menu and fill in the form.

Check out the official Micron Defense Force Discord server:
https://discord.gg/mKUcpNQejv


Best regards,

Mystical Dev
